```artifact
Feature: U02_1
  In order to meet the specified requirements
  As a system
  I want to ensure all functional requirements are validated

  Scenario: Coordinate every activity in Software Engineering process
    Given the system manages the Software Engineering process
    When an activity is initiated
    Then the system coordinates the activity

  Scenario: Guided by Prof. Chandrasekaran and other staff
    Given the system is under development
    When the system references guidance
    Then the system references Prof. Chandrasekaran and other staff

  Scenario Outline: Authorized chemists within zone provide discounted prices
    Given there is an authorized chemist located <location>
    When the system displays medicine prices
    Then the system shows discounted prices if <within_zone> is true, otherwise not

    Examples:
      | location | within_zone |
      | within   | true        |
      | outside  | false       |

  Scenario Outline: Door-step lab services available within service area
    Given the user's location is <location>
    When the system offers laboratory services
    Then the system provides door-step service if <within_service_area> is true, otherwise not

    Examples:
      | location | within_service_area |
      | within   | true                |
      | outside  | false               |
```
